# Conformal extension: summary of the frozen run (generated by conformal_figures.py; do not edit by hand)

Protocol: PROTOCOL_v2.md, sha256 5cbbf963789ce1b0e85e619a6005b321af5ca2e868db6a9de66e8c0f31d57ee6. Predictions: saved validation (calibration) and test predictions of 3 backbones x (published methods + Laplace family); alpha 0.1; 8 datasets, scaffold and random-0..2.
Calibration set = the validation split that was also used for early stopping (and for alpha / lambda of the Laplace family), so the finite-sample guarantee is approximate. Test sets were opened earlier for the baselines: exploratory.
